tests.title: California AB 325 / SB 763 takes effect
tests.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective before, applies after, for every CA address.

tests.title: Hoboken vs Jersey City local algorithmic bans
tests.expected_behavior: HOB-ALG-01 only for Hoboken addresses; JC-ALG-01 only for Jersey City addresses; neither for Newark.

tests.title: NJ FAIR Act: enacted, not yet effective; possible preemption
tests.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective on 2026-10-01, applies on 2027-07-02 for every NJ address; Jersey City and Hoboken addresses carry a conflict flag for human review.

tests.title: Massachusetts pending bills S.2983 and H.5222
tests.expected_behavior: Reported as pending (not in force) for every Boston and Cambridge address; affected set = all MA addresses if enacted.

tests.title: Massachusetts rent-control ballot question struck
tests.expected_behavior: No rent cap reported for any Boston or Cambridge address; IP 25-21 recorded as failed. Affected set is empty.

T1.notes: not_yet_effective before, applies after, for every CA address. Rules not found in rules.json for: CA-ALG-01. Check the extraction output for these.

T2.notes: HOB-ALG-01 only for Hoboken addresses; JC-ALG-01 only for Jersey City addresses; neither for Newark. Rules not found in rules.json for: HOB-ALG-01, JC-ALG-01. Check the extraction output for these.

T3.notes: not_yet_effective on 2026-10-01, applies on 2027-07-02 for every NJ address; Jersey City and Hoboken addresses carry a conflict flag for human review. Rules not found in rules.json for: NJ-ALG-01. Check the extraction output for these.

T4.notes: Reported as pending (not in force) for every Boston and Cambridge address; affected set = all MA addresses if enacted. Rules not found in rules.json for: MA-ALG-P1, MA-ALG-P2. Check the extraction output for these.

T5.notes: No rent cap reported for any Boston or Cambridge address; IP 25-21 recorded as failed. Affected set is empty. Rules not found in rules.json for: MA-RENT-P1. Check the extraction output for these.
